comment: DRAFT (RUNBOOK A.6 + A.10, 25 Oct 2026): C3 label sweep on deepthought (deepthought.etp.kit.edu, 4 x GTX TITAN X 12 GB, compute capability 5.2, driver 525.147.05), the primary sweep host (PLAN §10 R1-SWEEP-HOST, 24 Oct; no mixing hosts within one labelled table). SAME DESIGN AS THE ADA CONFIG (r1/scripts/configs/c3_sweep_ada.json): the eight D21 nodes, 18 instances, W = 20, both memory modes, liveness 2 x W = 10 memory on, transport retry 3, gates, audit K = 10 (7001..7010, 5 + 5). BACKEND llama.cpp (PLAN §10 R1-INFER-LLAMACPP, 25 Oct; RUNBOOK A.10): a dedicated llama-server per batch, pinned by the sha256 of the GGUF file (llamacpp.model_sha256) and the exact 'version: <n> (<commit>)' line of `llama-server --version` (llamacpp.build); the runner refuses on any mismatch, requires every layer offloaded to the GPU (server log; CPU fallback or partial offload is a STOP), the alias served on /v1/models and the GGUF path on /props. Collectors use the harness llamacpp provider (llamacpp/r1-manager, LLAMACPP_BASE_URL .../v1, D26 seed in each request). n_gpu_layers 999 = all layers; ctx_size 8192 and the alias are proposals (open question in BATCH_B_25OCT_HANDOFF). footprint_mib = the loaded server's GPU memory in MiB as measured by the one-token load probe on this host (co-tenancy margin, 13 Oct). AUTHOR ANSWERS (25 Oct): watchdog on; resume max_restarts 5, watchdog max_restarts 3; min_live_nodes 8 (a pool below 8 is an author decision, RUNBOOK §6); Paper A check = not applicable on this host (Paper A runs on zhixu experiment). Every "TODO_VERIFY_ON_HOST" value is read on the host (checklist in docs/r1/overnight/BATCH_B_25OCT_HANDOFF.md); the runner refuses to launch while any is left; `--check-config --allow-placeholders` validates the rest. AI-assisted (Claude); ENGINEERING_ONLY config; the sweep output is PILOT label data. ONE MANAGER PER TITAN: the runner drives ONE dedicated llama-server on ONE card per batch (gpu_uuid); four cards need four batches or a multi-instance runner (open question 3, not built). KNOWN RISK: llama.cpp must be built with CUDA for sm_52 against a toolkit the 525 driver supports (<= 12.0); RUNBOOK A.11 (one-token load probe proving full offload) comes before any use of this file.
